name: @userplane/zendesk
description: Zendesk app manifest packaging (UI lives in apps/dash)

scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp src/manifest.json dist/ && cp -r src/translations dist/ && cp src/assets/icon.svg dist/assets/ && ./scripts/inject-manifest-env.sh .env.production && cd dist && zip -r ../userplane.zip .
scripts.package:dev: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp src/manifest.json dist/ && cp -r src/translations dist/ && cp src/assets/icon.svg dist/assets/ && ./scripts/inject-manifest-env.sh .env.development && cd dist && zip -r ../userplane.zip .
